name: JoAi: Delete Segment

description.en: Permanently delete a saved audience segment. Segments that are used by a campaign cannot be deleted.
description.de: Ein gespeichertes Zielgruppen-Segment dauerhaft löschen. Segmente, die von einer Kampagne verwendet werden, können nicht gelöscht werden.
description.fr: Supprimer définitivement un segment d'audience enregistré. Les segments utilisés par une campagne ne peuvent pas être supprimés.
description.es: Elimina permanentemente un segmento de audiencia guardado. Los segmentos usados por una campaña no se pueden eliminar.
description.it: Elimina definitivamente un segmento di pubblico salvato. I segmenti usati da una campagna non possono essere eliminati.
description.ro: Șterge definitiv un segment de audiență salvat. Segmentele folosite de o campanie nu pot fi șterse.

bot: Use when the user wants to remove a saved segment. If the user refers to a segment by name, list segments first to find the matching ID.

inputs.name: Segment ID

description.en: The hashid of the segment to delete
description.de: Die Hashid des zu löschenden Segments
description.fr: Le hashid du segment à supprimer
description.es: El hashid del segmento a eliminar

inputs.bot: The segment hash ID. If the user refers to a segment by name, list segments first to find the matching ID.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug of the segment. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug des Segments. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.
description.fr: Slug d'équipe du segment. Par défaut l'équipe actuelle.
description.es: Slug del equipo del segmento. Por defecto el equipo actual.
description.it: Slug del team del segmento. Predefinito: team attuale.
description.ro: Slug-ul echipei segmentului. Implicit echipa curentă.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team the segment belongs to. Omit to use the current team.
